**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A description of the problem, e.g. "I always have to re-run the command
after the daily quota resets."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches, including how you work around it today.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, links to readers/engines that behave the way you want, or
any other context.
